items.title: use the Digital Credentials API to offer credentials
items.blurb: Starting from Chrome 155, Digital Credentials API issuance is enabled by default. The API makes it easier for websites to provision digital credentials to the user's preferred wallet app.

items.title: a polyfill pilot for WebMCP

items.title: Device Posture API
items.blurb: The Device Posture API allows developers to create user interfaces that adapt to a foldable device's posture and respond to posture changes.
